from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    freq = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line = freq.most_common(2)[1][0]
    rscore = [sum(v == line for v in row) for row in grid]
    cscore = [sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)]
    rmed, cmed = sorted(rscore)[h//2], sorted(cscore)[w//2]
    rs = [r for r,x in enumerate(rscore) if x > rmed]
    cs = [c for c,x in enumerate(cscore) if x > cmed]
    # Each output pixel is represented by a 2x2 block of marker values.
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c0,c1 in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
            vals=(grid[r0][c0],grid[r0][c1],grid[r1][c0],grid[r1][c1])
            row.append(vals[0] if len(set(vals))==1 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out

# Build demonstration grids from the described regular lattices and marker values.

from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    """Decode the image represented by values at intersections of grid lines."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_color = counts.most_common(2)[1][0]

    # Rows and columns that are grid lines have many occurrences of line_color.
    row_scores = [sum(value == line_color for value in row) for row in grid]
    col_scores = [sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)]
    row_median = sorted(row_scores)[h // 2]
    col_median = sorted(col_scores)[w // 2]
    marker_rows = [r for r, score in enumerate(row_scores) if score > row_median]
    marker_cols = [c for c, score in enumerate(col_scores) if score > col_median]

    # A pixel is colored only when all four corners of its marker-grid cell agree.
    result = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(marker_rows, marker_rows[1:]):
        out_row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(marker_cols, marker_cols[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            out_row.append(corners[0] if corners.count(corners[0]) == 4 else background)
        result.append(out_row)
    return result
